items.title: Run Koala CLI post-merge validation on main
items.context: Claude Code must run the relevant Koala CLI post-merge validation commands on /Users/jek/Documents/Work/Orchestrate main and record exact outputs. Minimum checks: session_brief, convergence_check, cli-validate, npm test after ensuring build output exists, git status.
items.userSees: Audit report section "Post-merge validation" includes quoted rows for "convergence_check", "cli-validate", "npm test", and "git status --short", each with observed pass/fail output rather than assumed green status.

happy.desc: Koala CLI main convergence_check output is recorded exactly, whether pass or fail
Koala CLI post-merge validation command outputs are recorded exactly and any failure is classified with evidence

edge.desc: Existing active INIT backlog is identified as unrelated and not mixed into this audit story

adversarial.desc: The audit does not modify production code in any repository

verificationEvidence.note: Claude recorded the exact convergence_check result in the Post-merge validation section and classified converged:false as expected because B-0f04 itself was in flight.

Report separates B-4622 and B-da5b as unrelated active INIT backlog and does not mix them into B-0f04.
Codex verified the Claude implementer commits only changed the audit evidence report, not production code.

items.title: Produce gap report and follow-up story recommendations
items.context: Claude Code must produce a concise report artifact under the story evidence directory. It should separate blockers, non-blocking advisories, already-solved items, and recommended follow-up stories. Codex will independently verify the highest-risk claims before DONE.
items.userSees: Audit report sections "Gaps and follow-up stories" and "Codex independent verification" name each recommended next story owner and explicitly list which high-risk claims Codex re-verified before recommendation.

happy.desc: Gap report is written and separates blockers, advisories, solved items, and follow-up stories

edge.desc: Report compares recommended follow-ups against currently active or known backlog and avoids duplicate recommendations

adversarial.desc: Codex independently verifies the report claims that could trigger new development work and records that verification as manual transcript evidence
